ModMetaData.name: HD5500 Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: HD5500 GPU Bridge
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld-side optimizer for slow PCs (built for an Intel HD 5500 laptop running RimWorld 1.7 through the HD5500 GPU Bridge). Version 0.3: (1) measurement - switches on RimWorld's own frame profiler when the bridge launcher asks for it (RW_OPT_PROFILE) and writes where the game's frame time goes, all threads; (2) settings "Maximum zoom-out", "Render thread before job workers" (thread priorities, on by default) and "Frame-rate cap" (Mod settings) - fewer map sections on screen when zoomed far out, measured to be where slow PCs lose frame rate. No patches; default settings change nothing.
